create_BLEUScorer: create a BLEUScorer instance to compute BLEU scores for hypothesis and reference sentence pairs
run_score_corpus: run corpus-level BLEU scoring on a list of hypotheses against multiple reference lists
test_score_sentences: test sentence-level BLEU scoring with per-sentence scores and configurable tokenizer
refactor_score_with_tags: refactor BLEU scoring to compute group-level scores filtered by tag subsets
summarize_get_default_args: summarize the get_default_args function that builds argparse.Namespace with BLEU configuration defaults
